title: Read the brief, write the plan — a Harbourline warm-up
feature: Framing a Devin task (no Devin execution): choosing a capability and the evidence that proves it worked
prerequisites: Repo cloned locally and `pnpm install` done at the root

matrix.fixture: Write the plan in a local Markdown file instead
matrix.note: Only the voice coach in section 8 needs Devin

credentials.fixture_only_story: Everything in this lab works offline. Without the voice coach you run the drill against a timer and self-score with the rubric in the answer.
not_exercised: A live Devin session — this warm-up deliberately asks for a plan, not an execution

scenarios.clean_state: `git status --short` prints nothing and there is no `labs/00-sample/PLAN.md`. This lab touches no database, no service and no Devin settings.

injectors.name: deadline-moved
injectors.behaviour: The facilitator (or the coach, in character) announces that the Lamp Week flash sale moved forward by one week. Your plan must say what changes and what does not.

references.title: Devin docs — Working with Devin: Agent vs Ask
